svg.aria-label: Top: the uniform aperture pattern against space frequency u is one curve for every length; an aperture 2, 5, or 20 wavelengths long sees it out to u = 2, 5, or 20. Bottom: the same three apertures against angle have beams 25.6, 10.2, and 2.5 degrees wide, and all three first sidelobes sit at -13.3 dB
